title: Annotrace: A Workbench for Step-Level Annotation of Agent Traces
title_zh: Annotrace：一个用于智能体轨迹步骤级标注的工作台

paragraphs.en: Every study of why LLM agents fail begins by labelling traces by hand, and every such study builds its own throwaway tool. Observability platforms record agent traces but offer no structured labelling; annotation tools label text but have no notion of a step, a delegation or a tool call, leaving it unclear what the smallest unit of execution to label should be. Annotrace reads six trace formats, including OpenTelemetry GenAI, LangSmith and Langfuse, and turns each run into an ordered, nested list of steps. The annotator writes their own labelling codebook; a frontier model proposes a starting set from a sample of their own traces, answers first, and is asked exactly the questions the human is asked, making annotation a joint human–AI process. Annotrace measures agreement between any two annotators, human or AI. On a multi-agent question-answering corpus it reproduces a previous manual effort’s 235 annotation units exactly, and two models labelling the same traces agree 91% of the time at κ = 0.82 \kappa=0.82 .
paragraphs.zh: 每一项关于大语言模型智能体为何失败的研究，都始于人工对轨迹进行标注，而每一项这样的研究都会构建自己的一次性工具。 可观测性平台记录智能体轨迹，但不提供结构化标注；标注工具可以标注文本，却没有“步骤”、委派或工具调用的概念，导致最小的标注执行单位是什么并不清楚。 Annotrace 可以读取六种轨迹格式，包括 OpenTelemetry GenAI、LangSmith 和 Langfuse，并将每次运行转换为有序、嵌套的步骤列表。 标注者编写自己的标注编码手册；一个前沿模型从其自身轨迹的样本中提出一个起始集合，先给出回答，并被问到与人类完全相同的问题，从而使标注成为一个人机协作的过程。 Annotrace 可以衡量任意两个标注者（无论是人类还是 AI）之间的一致性。 在一个多智能体问答语料库上，它精确复现了此前一项人工工作的 235 个标注单元，而且两个模型对相同轨迹进行标注时有 91% 的时间达成一致，κ = 0.82 \kappa=0.82。

paragraphs.en: Research on agent failure runs on hand-labelled traces. MAST derived its taxonomy from annotated traces across seven systems ( Cemri et al. 2025 ) ; Who&When annotated 127 failure logs to make attribution a benchmark task ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) ; AgentErrorTaxonomy was built the same way ( Zhu et al. 2025 ) , and AgentRx checks constraints against trajectories ( Barke et al. 2026 ) . Each began with people reading traces and writing labels, and each built disposable tooling to do it. Ours encoded our taxonomy and our trace format in its source, so nobody else could use it.
paragraphs.zh: 对智能体失败的研究依赖于人工标注的轨迹。 MAST 从七个系统的标注轨迹中得出了其分类体系（Cemri et al. 2025）；Who&When 标注了 127 条失败日志，将归因变成一个基准任务（Zhang et al. 2025）；AgentErrorTaxonomy 也以同样的方式构建（Zhu et al. 2025），而 AgentRx 则对照轨迹检查约束条件（Barke et al. 2026）。 每一项工作都始于人们阅读轨迹并编写标签，且每一项都为此构建了一次性的工具。 我们的工具将我们的分类体系和轨迹格式硬编码在其源代码中，因此其他人无法使用它。

sents.en: Ours encoded our taxonomy and our trace format in its source, so nobody else could use it.
sents.zh: 我们的工具将我们的分类体系和轨迹格式硬编码在其源代码中，因此其他人无法使用它。

paragraphs.en: Neither existing category of tool covers the job. Observability platforms — LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix — record and display traces faithfully, and OpenTelemetry now standardises them ( OpenTelemetry Authors 2025 ) , but none supports structured human labelling. Annotation tools — Label Studio ( Tkachenko et al. 2020 ) , doccano ( Nakayama et al. 2018 ) , INCEpTION ( Klie et al. 2018 ) — label well, but their unit is a span of text or a document. A trace is neither. It is a nested structure of decisions, delegations, tool calls and replies, and flattening it into a transcript destroys what a labeller needs: which step, of what kind, went wrong. AgentGraph reads traces into a knowledge graph and has a model detect failures in it ( Wu et al. 2026 ) ; the structure there feeds automatic analysis. Ours feeds a person, so a step is a thing to label and every label records who made it.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的两类工具都无法胜任这项工作。 可观测性平台——LangSmith、Langfuse、Arize Phoenix——能够忠实地记录并展示追踪，OpenTelemetry 如今也将追踪标准化了（OpenTelemetry Authors 2025），但它们都不支持结构化的人工标注。 标注工具——Label Studio（Tkachenko et al. 2020）、doccano（Nakayama et al. 2018）、INCEpTION（Klie et al. 2018）——擅长标注，但它们的标注单位是一段文本或一个文档，而追踪两者都不是。 追踪是一个由决策、委托、工具调用和回复组成的嵌套结构，把它压平成对话记录会破坏标注者所需的信息：是哪一步、什么类型的步骤出了错。 AgentGraph 将追踪读入知识图谱，并让模型在其中检测故障（Wu et al. 2026）；那里的结构服务于自动分析。 我们的结构服务于人，因此步骤是一个可供标注的对象，而且每条标注都记录了是谁做出的。

paragraphs.en: Annotrace makes the step the unit. Its users are researchers building failure taxonomies and practitioners reviewing deployed agents. It bridges two communities: it consumes the artefacts of agent observability and supports the practices of human data annotation, with a model as proposer inside the loop.
paragraphs.zh: Annotrace 将步骤作为基本单位。 它的用户是构建失败分类体系的研究者，以及审查已部署智能体的从业者。 它连接了两个群体：它消费智能体可观测性的产物，并支持人工数据标注的实践，让模型作为提桊者处于流程之中。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 is one run from our demo set. It answers correctly, so every label a trace-level scheme can give it says success. Its steps say otherwise, and the decisive one sits two levels down.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 是我们演示集的一次运行。 它回答正确，因此轨迹级方案能给它的每个标签都说它是成功。 它的步骤却说明并非如此，而起决定作用的那一步位于下面两层。

paragraphs.en: Annotrace is a Streamlit application of about 3,200 lines, 823 of them format adapters (Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: Annotrace 是一个约 3,200 行代码的 Streamlit 应用程序，其中 823 行是格式适配器（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: An adapter turns one format into Step objects carrying named fields, an actor, a kind and a nesting depth. Six ship (Table 1 ). Detection reads file content — each adapter looks for a marker no other format uses, such as run_type with dotted_order for LangSmith — so the user need not know what they were given.
paragraphs.zh: 适配器将一种格式转换为携带命名字段、执行者（actor）、类型（kind）和嵌套深度的 Step 对象。共内置六种（见表 1）。 检测会读取文件内容——每个适配器只寻找一种其他格式不会使用的标记，例如 LangSmith 的 run_type 配合 dotted_order——因此用户无需知道自己拿到的是哪种格式。

sents.en: An adapter turns one format into Step objects carrying named fields, an actor, a kind and a nesting depth. Six ship (Table 1 ).
sents.zh: 适配器将一种格式转换为携带命名字段、执行者（actor）、类型（kind）和嵌套深度的 Step 对象。共内置六种（见表 1）。

sents.en: Detection reads file content — each adapter looks for a marker no other format uses, such as run_type with dotted_order for LangSmith — so the user need not know what they were given.
sents.zh: 检测会读取文件内容——每个适配器只寻找一种其他格式不会使用的标记，例如 LangSmith 的 run_type 配合 dotted_order——因此用户无需知道自己拿到的是哪种格式。

paragraphs.en: Granularity differs by format and is exposed rather than chosen. Where a worker’s reasoning is one text field of interleaved think , search , information and answer tags, the adapter recovers Thinking-Action-Response cycles (Figure 3 ). A step containing finer steps is left unselected, so nothing is labelled twice.
paragraphs.zh: 粒度因格式而异，且是被呈现出来而非可自行选择的。 当智能体的推理是穿插着 think、search、information 和 answer 标签的单个文本字段时，适配器会从中恢复出「思考—行动—响应」循环（图 3）。 包含更细步骤的步骤不会被选中，因此没有任何内容被重复标注。

sents.en: Granularity differs by format and is exposed rather than chosen.
sents.zh: 粒度因格式而异，且是被呈现出来而非可自行选择的。

sents.zh: 包含更细步骤的步骤不会被选中，因此没有任何内容被重复标注。

paragraphs.en: A schema is a list of questions, each with a prompt, the labels the user typed, the step kinds it applies to, and optionally a condition on an earlier answer: ask “what went wrong?” only when “severity” is “Critical” . Conditions are authored in the interface, not a file. No taxonomy ships; the three included schemas are examples a user may delete.
paragraphs.zh: 模式（schema）是一系列问题，每个问题包含提示语、用户输入的标签、适用的步骤类型，以及可选的针对先前答案的条件：仅当“严重性”为“Critical”时才询问“出了什么问题？”。 条件是在界面中编写的，而不是在文件中。 不内置任何分类体系；随附的三个模式只是示例，用户可以删除。

sents.en: A schema is a list of questions, each with a prompt, the labels the user typed, the step kinds it applies to, and optionally a condition on an earlier answer: ask “what went wrong?” only when “severity” is “Critical” .
sents.zh: 模式（schema）是一系列问题，每个问题包含提示语、用户输入的标签、适用的步骤类型，以及可选的针对先前答案的条件：仅当“严重性”为“Critical”时才询问“出了什么问题？”。

sents.zh: 条件是在界面中编写的，而不是在文件中。

sents.en: No taxonomy ships; the three included schemas are examples a user may delete.
sents.zh: 不内置任何分类体系；随附的三个模式只是示例，用户可以删除。

paragraphs.en: A model is used twice, both times asked the questions the human is asked, generated from the same object. It reads ten randomly sampled runs and proposes a starting schema — at most three questions, four labels each, with house rules — then answers a trace. Every answer records whether a person or the model produced it; a suggestion never overwrites a human decision, and editing one makes it the annotator’s. Any of 46 models may be chosen, so a cheap model can draft and an expensive one check.
paragraphs.zh: 同一个模型被使用两次，两次都被问到与人类相同的问题，这些问题由同一个对象生成。 它读取十个随机抽取的运行记录并提出一个初始模式——最多三个问题，每个问题四个标签，并附带内部规则——然后回答一条轨迹。 每个答案都会记录是由人还是模型产生的；建议永远不会覆盖人类的决定，一旦编辑某个建议，它就归标注者所有。 可以从 46 个模型中任选其一，因此可以用便宜的模型起草，用昂贵的模型检查。

sents.en: A model is used twice, both times asked the questions the human is asked, generated from the same object.
sents.zh: 同一个模型被使用两次，两次都被问到与人类相同的问题，这些问题由同一个对象生成。

sents.en: It reads ten randomly sampled runs and proposes a starting schema — at most three questions, four labels each, with house rules — then answers a trace.
sents.zh: 它读取十个随机抽取的运行记录并提出一个初始模式——最多三个问题，每个问题四个标签，并附带内部规则——然后回答一条轨迹。

sents.en: Every answer records whether a person or the model produced it; a suggestion never overwrites a human decision, and editing one makes it the annotator’s.
sents.zh: 每个答案都会记录是由人还是模型产生的；建议永远不会覆盖人类的决定，一旦编辑某个建议，它就归标注者所有。

sents.en: Any of 46 models may be chosen, so a cheap model can draft and an expensive one check.
sents.zh: 可以从 46 个模型中任选其一，因此可以用便宜的模型起草，用昂贵的模型检查。

paragraphs.en: Two annotation sets are compared question by question, reporting raw agreement, Cohen’s κ \kappa and the steps they disagree on; either side may be the open session. κ \kappa is reported because raw agreement flatters an uneven schema.
paragraphs.zh: 两套标注集按问题逐题比较，报告原始一致率、Cohen's κ \kappa 以及它们不一致的步骤；任意一方都可以是开放式会话。之所以报告 κ \kappa，是因为原始一致率会夸大不均衡的标注方案的效果。

paragraphs.en: Existing tools ask for a label set before the annotator has read anything. Annotrace shows the traces first, then proposes labels from a sample of them. Given the one-line goal “which step caused the run to give a wrong answer”, a model proposed Was this step correct? Yes / No / Irrelevant with rules including “pick No only if you can see a clear mistake”. The proposal lands in editable fields and is never applied unasked.
paragraphs.zh: 现有工具在标注者还没有读过任何内容之前就要求提供一组标签。 Annotrace 先展示轨迹，然后从其中抽取样本提出标签。 给定一行目标「是哪一步导致运行给出了错误答案」，模型提议了「这一步是否正确？」。 是 / 否 / 不相关，并带有规则，例如「只有当你能看到明显错误时才选『否』」。 提议的内容落在可编辑的字段中，且绝不会在未被要求的情况下被自动应用。

sents.zh: 现有工具在标注者还没有读过任何内容之前就要求提供一组标签。

sents.zh: Annotrace 先展示轨迹，然后从其中抽取样本提出标签。

sents.en: Yes / No / Irrelevant with rules including “pick No only if you can see a clear mistake”.
sents.zh: 是 / 否 / 不相关，并带有规则，例如「只有当你能看到明显错误时才选『否』」。

sents.en: The proposal lands in editable fields and is never applied unasked.
sents.zh: 提议的内容落在可编辑的字段中，且绝不会在未被要求的情况下被自动应用。

paragraphs.en: On a 40-run multi-agent corpus the coordinator adapter reproduced all 235 Thinking-Action-Response unit keys of a previous hand-built effort, on 40 of 40 runs, so earlier work still aligns. Two models labelling the same six runs agreed on 91% of 22 answers at κ = 0.82 \kappa=0.82 . A schema proposal takes about four seconds, annotating a run three to five, at a fraction of a cent per call. Renaming a label keeps and marks the answers that used the old name rather than discarding them. Figure 4 shows the annotation screen: a visitor loads a run, types one line saying what they are looking for, takes the proposed labels, and disagrees with the model on a step, in under two minutes.
